ayahs.1: Alif-Lam-Mim — opening this surah whose full meaning rests with Allah.
ayahs.2: The revelation of this Book is, beyond doubt, from the Rabb of all that exists — every realm of creation.
ayahs.3: Do they say he invented it? No — it is the truth from your Rabb, so you may warn a people no warner reached before you, that they may be guided.
ayahs.4: Allah created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, then settled upon the Throne — the seat of His dominion. You have no protector or intercessor besides Him. Will you not then live with taqwa?
ayahs.5: He conducts every affair from the heavens to the earth; then it all ascends to Him on a Day whose length is a thousand years by your counting.
ayahs.6: That is the Knower of the seen and unseen — the Almighty, the Rahim — whose special mercy is reserved for believers in the Akhirah.
ayahs.7: Who perfected everything He created, and began the creation of humankind from clay.
ayahs.8: Then made his descendants from an extract of humble fluid,
ayahs.9: then fashioned them and breathed into them of His spirit, and gave you hearing, sight, and intellect — yet you give little thanks.
ayahs.10: They ask mockingly: When we are scattered in the earth, will we really be raised anew? They are in denial of meeting their Rabb.
ayahs.11: Say, O Prophet: The angel of death, who is set over you, will take your souls. Then to your Rabb you will all be returned.
ayahs.12: If only you could see the wrongdoers hanging their heads before their Rabb: Our Rabb, we have seen and heard — send us back and we will do good. We now have sure iman!
ayahs.13: Had We willed, We could have imposed guidance on every soul. But My word stands: I will surely fill Hell with jinn and humans together.
ayahs.14: So taste the punishment for neglecting this Day of yours. We too will neglect you. Taste eternal torment for what you used to do.
ayahs.15: The true believers in Our revelation are those who, when it is recited to them, fall into prostration, glorify their Rabb, and are not too proud.
ayahs.16: They leave their beds calling on their Rabb with hope and fear, and give from what We provided them.
ayahs.17: No soul knows what delights are kept hidden for them as reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.18: Is the believer equal to the rebellious? They are not equal.
ayahs.19: Those who believe and do good will have Gardens of lasting residence as reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.20: But the rebellious — the Fire is their home. Whenever they try to escape, they are driven back and told: Taste the Fire's torment that you used to deny.
ayahs.21: We will certainly let them taste lesser torment in this dunya before the greater torment of the Akhirah, so perhaps they will return.
ayahs.22: Who does greater wrong than one reminded of Allah's ayahs yet turns away? We will surely punish the wicked.
ayahs.23: We gave the Scripture to Moses — let there be no doubt, O Prophet, that you too receive revelation — and made it a guide for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.24: We raised leaders among them who guided by Our command when they bore sabr and held firm iman in Our signs.
ayahs.25: Your Rabb will decide between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences.
ayahs.26: Is it not clear to them how many peoples We destroyed before them, whose ruins they pass? In that are signs. Will they not listen?
ayahs.27: Do they not see how We drive rain to barren land and produce crops they and their cattle eat? Will they not see?
ayahs.28: They ask mockingly: When is this Decision, if you speak truth?
ayahs.29: Say, O Prophet: On the Day of Decision it will not benefit those who rejected the truth to believe then, nor will they be delayed.
ayahs.30: So turn away from them and wait. They too are waiting.
